Fresh MPI QMP, parscalar double QDP/OpenMP, serial and MPI SuperbBLAS, standalone datalib and ADAT-free Chroma from matching reorg branches. Chroma executes with two MPI ranks and two OpenMP threads per rank, explicitly set by a per-rank executor; the unchanged runner sets the single-process NPT reference to one OpenMP worker. Each real Chroma rank is independently RSS-monitored, not just mpirun. Cached native-double tensors and explicit DISCO supplement; zero CG solves; original deferrals, 8192 MiB RSS cap per actual rank process, 2 GiB planner and SB_CACHEGB_CPU=1 unchanged. Legacy QDP SIMD unit-program compile failure is preserved separately and does not establish an MPI runtime failure.
